slots.notes: Fullscreen still background of the h-screen parallax container (bg-cover bg-center, overflow-hidden), sitting behind the footer card and beneath the foreground truck layer; opaque landscape scene that the truck reads against. Cover-cropped so a wide ~16:9 source fits any viewport.

Foreground hero subject in the parallax layer (motion.div absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-full, z-20, pointer-events-none): a transparent-PNG cutout rendered object-contain object-bottom origin-bottom and scaled up responsively (scale-[1.5] mobile -> scale-110 sm -> scale-[2.0] md -> scale-105 lg). Its y is driven by useTransform([0,1]->[-50,150]) so it parallaxes against the background. Must be a bottom-anchored alpha cutout; the scale ladder is tuned to a wide vehicle silhouette.

Brand glyph reversed white inside a 40x40 (mobile) / 48x48 (desktop) bg-orange-500 rounded-lg shadow-inner p-2 square in the footer card's logo area, sitting next to the 'HAUL!' wordmark. Native art is an inline <svg viewBox="0 0 256 256"> with a single white <path> (an interlocking-corners motif); reskin = swap the path data, not a URL. The colorRole tints the square the icon sits in.

Four w-5 h-5 lucide-react glyphs (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Linkedin, in that order) in the bottom bar's right side, each wrapped in a 40x40 circle with border-gray-100; default gray, on hover the circle fills bg-orange-500 with white icon + orange-500 border (transition all duration-300).

Single typeface for the whole footer (native: Inter, Google Fonts weights 400/500/600/700), set as the default sans; carries the 'HAUL!' wordmark (bold, tracking-tighter), the 'View Below' eyebrow (bold uppercase tracking-[0.5em]), the uppercase tracking-widest column headers, the gray link items, and the copyright line.

mechanic: A 'View Below' spacer sits above an h-screen background-image section in which a top-aligned bg-white/95 backdrop-blur footer card slides+fades down on mount while a bottom-anchored foreground truck PNG parallaxes via useScroll/useTransform(scrollYProgress [0,1] -> y [-50,150]) against the static background.
techDelivery: React functional component using Tailwind CSS, motion/react (useScroll/useTransform/motion + initial/animate) for the parallax and entrance animations, and lucide-react for the social icons; Inter loaded from Google Fonts.
reskinNotes: The brand mark is a hardcoded inline <svg viewBox="0 0 256 256"> with a fixed white <path d=...> inside an orange square, so reswapping the logo means editing path data, not a src. Colors are Tailwind utility classes baked into markup (bg-orange-500, text-orange-600, text-gray-900/500/300, border-gray-100, bg-[#FDFDFD]) rather than CSS variables, so every accent/neutral must be remapped at the class level. All copy is hardcoded in JSX: the 'View Below' eyebrow, the 'HAUL!' wordmark (appears twice -- logo + copyright), the three nav column titles + their link labels, and the '(c) 2026 HAUL! All Rights Reserved' line. The parallax useTransform range and the truck's four-breakpoint scale ladder (1.5/1.1/2.0/1.05) are tuned to a wide, bottom-anchored vehicle silhouette; a differently-proportioned brand cutout will need the scale classes re-tuned to avoid clipping.
